name: Mozu
source:
Taisho period, Tokyo.... The main character comes back to his hometown from Europe... to revenge on people who betrayed his father and cornered his family to death. He looks for his enemies one by one... and approaches an innocent girl.... I am back to the land of revenge.... The dawn of party....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305062934/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_45/products_id/1004949]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
大正時代，東京……主角從歐洲返回故鄉，要向那些背叛父親、把全家逼上絕路的人復仇。他逐一尋找仇家……並接近一名無辜少女……我已經回到這片復仇之地……宴會的黎明即將到來……

[出自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305062934/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_45/products_id/1004949]Eroge Shop[/url]]
